body:
# NOSTALGIC BakaSU (ReSukiSU) 35212

This release provides 158 checksum-verified OnePlus kernel packages built with BakaSU 35212 and SuSFS 2.3.0.

- 38 kernel 5.10 packages
- 25 kernel 5.15 packages
- 53 kernel 6.1 packages
- 34 kernel 6.6 packages
- 8 kernel 6.12 packages
- OxygenOS 14, 15 and 16 targets
- Normal universal BakaSU manager
- Spoofed universal BakaSU manager
- NoMount v2.0.0 companion module
- Clang O2 builds

BakaSU is the current continuation and new identity of ReSukiSU. The combined name is shown so existing ReSukiSU users can recognize the project.

Use only the ZIP matching the exact device, OxygenOS generation and kernel version. Keep a known-good boot image and recovery path before flashing.

The included `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all 158 kernel ZIPs, the NoMount module and both manager APKs.

Manager source: Baka-SU/BakaSU commit `e5423590bec3e24daffa4e9555c9592071319c68`.
